The company provides branded and generic formulations in therapeutic areas of dermatology, respiratory, and oncology; and various active pharmaceutical ingredients.

GREENLAM.NS.d: Greenlam Industries Limited manufactures and sells laminates, decorative veneers, and their allied products in India and internationally. The company operates through Laminate & Allied Products and Veneered & Allied Products segments.

HAL.NS.d: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited engages in the design, development, manufacture, repair, overhaul, upgrade, and servicing of aircraft, helicopters, aero-engines, avionics, accessories, and aerospace structures in India and internationally. It offers power plants; and materials, including castings, general and precision forgings, powder metallurgy products, rubber products, rolled rings, and composites.

HEIDELBERG.NS.d: HeidelbergCement India Limited manufactures and sells cement in India. It offers Portland pozzolana cement and Portland slag cement under the Mycem and Mycem Power brand. The company was formerly known as Mysore Cements Limited and changed its name to HeidelbergCement India Limited in April 2009. HeidelbergCement India Limited was incorporated in 1958 and is based in Gurugram, India. HeidelbergCement India Limited is a subsidiary of Cementrum I.B.V.

HESTERBIO.NS.d: Hester Biosciences Limited manufactures and trades in veterinary vaccines and health products in India. It operates through Poultry healthcare, Animal Healthcare, and Others segments. The Poultry Healthcare segment vaccines for diseases such as fowl pox, Newcastle disease, infectious bronchitis, and others; feed supplements, such as growth tonic, toxin binder, and herbal supplement; disinfectants for farms and equipment; and sanitizers.

HOLMARC.NS.d: Holmarc Opto-Mechatronics Ltd. designs, develops, and manufactures a diverse range of precision optical and mechatronics solutions, scientific instruments, and devices. The company's primary products include optical components, optical systems, opto-mechanical systems, laser systems, educational kits, imaging and measuring instruments, spectroscopy equipment, analytical instruments, laboratory equipment, physics lab equipment, and linear and rotation stages, including motorized variants.

HONASA.NS.d: Honasa Consumer Limited is a beauty and personal care company in India that sells mainly through digital channels. Its products cover baby care, face, body and hair care, color cosmetics and fragrances, under brands such as Mamaearth, The Derma Co., Aqualogica, Ayuga and Dr. Sheth's. It also runs the BBlunt salon network and the Momspresso content platform. Established in 2016, it is headquartered in Gurugram.

INDIANHUME.NS.d: The Indian Hume Pipe Company Limited engages in the construction contract activities in India. It engages in manufacturing, laying, and jointing pipelines. The company undertakes water supply projects for the supply of drinking and irrigation water; and sewer and drainage pipelines for cities and towns, as well as designs, fabricates, and installs penstock pipes for hydroelectric projects, and cooling water pipelines for thermal power plants.

INDOFARM.NS.d: Indo Farm Equipment Limited, established in 1994 in Baddi, India, makes and sells agricultural, industrial and construction machinery, mainly in India. Its divisions are Tractors and Cranes, other ventures and a non-banking financial company, and its agricultural products include tractors, rotary tillers and harvesters.

JAYKAY.NS.d: Jaykay Enterprises Limited is an Indian company with interests in various sectors, including textiles, cement, and real estate. They are involved in manufacturing and trading activities. The company is located in India.

KANCHI.NS.d: Kanchi Karpooram Limited manufactures and sells camphor and related products. Their products are used in pharmaceuticals, fragrance, and other industries. The company is based in Chennai, India.

KARNIKA.NS.d: Karnika Industries Ltd. is an Indian apparel manufacturer primarily focused on the infants' and kids' wear segment, targeting children from 0 to 14 years old. The company operates as an integrated player within the garment industry, managing processes from design through to the final production of both knitted and woven apparel. Its product range includes T-shirts, joggers, infant suits, pajamas, dresses, denims, leggings, skirts, and ponchos, among other children's clothing, and also produces jeans for adults.

KAVDEFENCE.NS.d: Kavveri Defence & Wireless Technologies Limited, established in Bengaluru in 1991, develops, designs and produces radio frequency products and antennas for telecommunications, defence and space customers in India and abroad. Its antenna range includes omnidirectional, directional panel and sectoral types.

LAKPRE.NS.d: Lakshmi Precision Screws Limited manufactures, sells, and trades in high tensile fasteners primarily in India. The company's products include bolts and screws, pins, nuts, and allen keys. Its products are used in various sectors, such as wind energy, oil and gas, locomotives, automobiles, agriculture equipment, defense, electronic and communication, construction, tool and die, machine building, and various other sectors.

LPDC.NS.d: Landmark Property Development Company Limited engages in the real estate development business in India. It also offers advisory and consultancy services to overseas investors for investment reports, including presentation of the financial and economic aspects of the proposed investment, business plans for the proposed investment, and various other information requested by the advisee.

LTF.NS.d: L&T Finance Ltd is an India-based non-banking financial company with four segments: Retail Finance, Wholesale Finance, Defocused Business and Others. The retail division serves a range of customers, including farmer finance covering equipment and agriculture-related lending.

METROGLOBL.NS.d: MetroGlobal Limited is a technology company that offers IT services, software solutions, and e-governance solutions. The company caters to government and private sector clients. The company is based in India.

MIIL.NS.d: Meghna Infracon Infrastructure Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker MIIL and traded in INR. Its country is India.

NCLIND.NS.d: NCL Industries Limited manufactures and sells building materials in India. It operates through five segments: Cement, Boards, Doors, Energy, and Ready Mix Concrete. It offers cement, including ordinary Portland and pozzolana Portland cement under the Nagarjuna brand name; and special cement for supply to Indian Railways for concrete sleepers and pre-stressed concrete works.

NESTLEIND-BL.NS.d: Nestle India Limited is a subsidiary of Nestlé S.A., a multinational food and beverage company. The company manufactures and markets a wide range of food products in India, including milk products, infant nutrition, beverages, and prepared foods. It is headquartered in Gurgaon, India.

PAVNAIND.NS.d: Pavna Industries Limited and its subsidiaries make and distribute automotive components worldwide. Its OEM range includes ignition switches, fuel tank caps, latches, locks, handles, pumps, carburetors, throttle bodies and engine and casting parts, and it supplies aftermarket parts such as filters, clutch plates, bearings, wipers and brake shoes.

RELINFRA.NS.d: Reliance Infrastructure Limited, an infrastructure company, engages in the generation, transmission, and distribution of electrical power to residential, industrial, commercial, and other customers in India. It operates through three segments: Power; Engineering and Construction; and Infrastructure.

RRKABEL.NS.d: R R Kabel Limited, headquartered in Vadodara, India, makes and sells electrical wires and cables and fast-moving electrical goods (FMEG). Its cables include household wiring, industrial, power transmission and specialised cables, while its FMEG range includes electric fans and lighting fixtures.

SHAKTIPUMP.NS.d: Shakti Pumps (India) Limited manufactures and sells submersible pumps and motors under the Shakti brand name in India. The company operates through 4 segments: Government Solar, OEM, Exports, and Domestic and Industrials.

SHALBY.NS.d: Shalby Limited operates multi-specialty hospitals primarily in India. The company offers arthroscopy, arthroplasty, cardiology, cardiothoracic and vascular surgery, cosmetic and aesthetic, dental cosmetic and implant ology, emergency medicine, endocrinology, endoscopy and laparoscopy, ENT surgery, gastroentero surgery, gastroenterology, general medicine and surgery, hair transplant, liver disease and transplant, and hip and knee joint replacement services.

SHIVALIK.NS.d: Shivalik Rasayan Limited is a New Delhi-based Indian company that makes pharmaceutical and agrochemical products. Rahul Bishnoi founded it on March 16, 1979. Its range includes organophosphorus insecticides and other chemicals.

SHRADDHA.NS.d: Shraddha Prime Projects Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker SHRADDHA and traded in INR. Its country is India.

SJS.NS.d: S.J.S. Enterprises Limited was founded in 1987 in Bengaluru and designs, develops and manufactures decorative aesthetic parts, mainly for automotive original equipment makers in India. Products include decals, graphics, 3D badges, appliques, dials, overlays, in-mould labels, chrome-plated parts and painted plastic components. It also sells aftermarket accessories for two-wheelers.

SRTRANSFIN-ZH.NS.d: Sec Red NCD 9% Sr.V represents a secured, redeemable, non-convertible debenture issued by Shriram Transport Finance Limited, offering a fixed interest rate of 9% and belonging to Series V of the issuance; it is a debt instrument used by the company to raise capital from the public; Shriram Transport Finance Limited is an asset financing NBFC focused on providing financing solutions to commercial vehicle owners.

TCL.NS.d: Thaai Casting Ltd. is an automotive ancillary company specializing in precision aluminum die casting and comprehensive engineering solutions. The company's operations encompass High-Pressure Die Casting (HPDC), Low-Pressure Die Casting (LPDC), precision machining of both ferrous and non-ferrous materials, induction heating and quenching, gas nitriding, gear shaping, and heavy machining.

TEAMLEASE.NS.d: TeamLease Services Limited provides human resource services to various industries in India. The company offers temporary staffing, permanent recruitment, payroll process outsourcing, regulatory compliance, vocational training/education and assessment, and IT and telecom staffing services; apprenticeship program and property leasing services; and online service for software product engineering.

TOYAMSL.NS.d: Toyam Sports Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker TOYAMSL and traded in INR. Its country is India.

UTKARSHBNK.NS.d: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank Limited is an Indian bank offering deposit accounts of the tax-saving, recurring, fixed and savings kinds, along with debit and credit cards, and loans for individuals including home loans, loans against property, personal loans and gold loans. It also offers life insurance products.

VASUPRADA.NS.d: Shri Vasuprada Plantations Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker VASUPRADA and traded in INR. Its country is India.

VINDHYATEL.NS.d: Vindhya Telelinks Limited manufactures and sells cables in India. It operates in two segments, Cables; and Engineering, Procurement, and Construction. The company offers fiber optic cables, including central-tube, multi-tube single sheath, multi-tube double sheath, breakout tight buffered, fan out tight buffered, and multi-tube double layer unarmored cables; central-tube steel tape, multi-tube single sheath, multi-tube double sheath, multi-tube steel wire, multi-tube FRP rod, and hybrid underground armored cables;…

VINNY.NS.d: Vinny Overseas Limited is an Indian company that produces and treats textile materials. Its range includes polyester that goes into apparel, home furnishings, industrial textiles and electrical insulation, as well as rayon, cotton fabrics for dresses, kurtis and shirts, denim and polyester-viscose and polyester-cotton blends.
